title.zh: 将东内格罗斯省 Tanjay市镇 Tabuc 小学的名称变更为Jose Rotea 纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act to Change the Name of Tabuc Primary School in the Municipality of Tanjay, Province of Negros Oriental, to Jose Rotea Memorial School
title.orig: An Act to Change the Name of Tabuc Primary School in the Municipality of Tanjay, Province of Negros Oriental, to Jose Rotea Memorial School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Tiểu học Tabuc tại Đô thị Tanjay, Tỉnh Negros Oriental thành Trường Tưởng niệm Jose Rotea
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Tabuc ในเทศบาล Tanjay จังหวัด Negros Oriental เป็นโรงเรียนอนุสรณ์ Jose Rotea
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Dasar Tabuc di Kotamadya Tanjay, Provinsi Negros Oriental menjadi Sekolah Memorial Jose Rotea
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Rendah Tabuc di Perbandaran Tanjay, Wilayah Negros Oriental kepada Sekolah Memorial Jose Rotea

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2576_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In recognition of the many acts of liberality and generosity offered by the late Jose Rotea for the establishment and development of the barrio school in Barrio Tabuc, Municipality of Tanjay, Province of Negros Oriental, the name of Tabuc Primary School is hereby changed to Jose Rotea Memorial School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
